svg.title: Smooth forcing, singular velocity, and two domains
svg.desc: A smooth force is supported between a and b. Velocity and energy stay at zero until a. The velocity then blows up at time 1, and the energy levels off below a bound. Comparison with a competitor yields a compactness contradiction. Separated copies in a cell give the periodic statement. Arrows reach C and D. A and B stay outside them.

text.tspan: continuous global competitor bounded on K×[0,1]
equal pre-singular branch has unbounded speed in K
finite cell energy; no whole-space L2 claim
